about.title: About Fibidy
about.tagline: POS & Online Store Platform for Indonesian Small Businesses.
summary: Fibidy is not a marketplace — we don't sell your products or take a commission.
We build tools so your business is easier to record and easier to find.

sections.title: What Fibidy is.
content: Fibidy is a SaaS platform that provides two tools for Indonesian small business owners: an offline POS for recording daily transactions, and a storefront builder for creating an online store you can fill in yourself in minutes.

Fibidy is not a marketplace. Your products are not displayed alongside other sellers', we take no commission from your sales, and we never hold money from your transactions. All buying and selling happens directly between you and your customers.

sections.title: Who we serve.
content: Fibidy is designed for small and medium businesses across Indonesia — from warungs, salons, and coffee shops to repair shops, pharmacies, and minimarkets. We have more than 20 industry-specific versions, each with features tailored to that sector's needs.
Our priority is simplicity: online store setup in 5 minutes, a POS that keeps working without a signal, and pricing that makes sense at the small business scale.

sections.title: How we operate.
content: Users register an account, choose a store template, and manage their own product catalog through the Fibidy dashboard. The resulting online store can be linked directly in social media bios — customers tap, view products, and contact the seller.

For full feature access (including the offline POS), users can upgrade to the Starter plan (Rp 35,000 per month, one payment per period via QRIS). The Free plan remains available at no cost with a more limited online store.

sections.title: Contact.
content: For questions, feedback, or partnerships, reach us at admin@fibidy.com or WhatsApp +62 858-1508-6235. Our team is based in Madiun, East Java, Indonesia.

terms.title: Terms of Service
summary: Fibidy is an offline POS and online store platform for small businesses not a marketplace.
All transactions happen outside Fibidy, directly between you (the Seller) and your customers.
Fibidy never receives, holds, or transfers money of any kind.
You can leave anytime. Your store data stays intact, just downgraded to the Free plan limits.

sections.title: About Fibidy.
content: Fibidy is a platform that helps small businesses manage two things: daily transaction recording through an offline POS, and an online presence through a self-managed online store.
Fibidy is not a marketplace. We do not sell your products, display your products alongside other sellers' in a shared catalog for buyers to compare, or take a commission from your sales.
For all official communication regarding these Terms of Service, use admin@fibidy.com.

sections.title: Your account.
content: To use Fibidy, you need to register and fill in basic business information (store name, contact, business type). You are responsible for keeping your account credentials confidential and for all activity that occurs within your account.

Fibidy can be used for many types of businesses warungs, salons, coffee shops, repair shops, and more as long as you use it for its intended purpose: recording transactions and displaying your business information.

sections.title: Transactions happen outside Fibidy.
content: This is the most important part: Fibidy is not involved in any transactions between you and your customers.

What happens in the online store: customers view your products or services on your store page, then contact you directly via WhatsApp, phone, or other contact details you provide. Price agreements, payments (e.g. via QRIS), and delivery happen directly between you and the customer, outside of Fibidy.

What happens in the offline POS: you record transactions that occur at your own store (cash, or other methods you accept directly). These records are saved on your device and can be synced when a connection is available.
Fibidy never holds, temporarily stores, or forwards money from these transactions in any form.

sections.title: Your responsibilities as a seller.
content: Because transactions happen directly between you and your customers, you are responsible for the accuracy of the product or service information you display, price agreements, payment, and delivery with your customers, and handling complaints, refunds, or warranties in accordance with the policies you set for your customers.
Fibidy does not mediate, guarantee, or bear any responsibility for the outcome of those transactions.

sections.title: Prohibited activities.
content: You may not use Fibidy to sell illegal goods or services, or anything that violates applicable law; display content that is misleading, fraudulent, or infringes on the rights of others; or attempt to disrupt, overload, or break into Fibidy's systems.
We reserve the right to deactivate accounts that violate the above.

sections.title: Plans and payments to Fibidy.
content: Fibidy offers a Free plan and a Starter plan. Feature details and pricing for each plan are listed on the Pricing page.

Payment for the Starter plan is your payment to Fibidy for using the service (not part of your sales transactions with customers). If you stop paying for Starter, your account downgrades to the Free plan limits your data stays intact, but some features (including the offline POS) become inactive until you resubscribe.

sections.title: Your store data.
content: Data you enter into Fibidy (products, photos, business info, POS transaction history) remains yours. You can download a backup anytime through the feature available in your account.
If you cancel your subscription, your data is not deleted it simply downgrades to the Free plan limits.

sections.title: Service changes.
content: Fibidy may update its features, interface, or these terms from time to time. Important changes will be communicated via email or a notification in your account.

sections.title: Limitation of liability.
content: Fibidy is an operational tool. We strive to keep the service running well, but we are not liable for losses arising from transactions between you and your customers, or disruptions caused by third parties (internet providers, devices, etc.).

sections.title: Governing law.
content: These Terms of Service are governed by the laws of the Republic of Indonesia. Questions about these terms can be sent to admin@fibidy.com.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
summary: Fibidy stores store owner (Seller) data not buyer customer data.
Customer data that flows through WhatsApp is never stored by Fibidy.
Offline POS data is stored on your device and synced when a connection is available.
You can download a backup or request deletion of your account data at any time.

sections.title: Data we collect.
content: Fibidy collects data you provide as a store owner (Seller), including: account data (name, WhatsApp number, email, business type), store data (product names, photos, prices, descriptions, and other business information you fill in), and POS transaction data (daily transaction records you input through the offline cashier app).

Fibidy does not collect or store your customers' (buyers') data. When a customer contacts you via WhatsApp from your online store, the conversation and their data flow directly through WhatsApp they do not pass through or get stored on Fibidy's servers.

sections.title: Offline POS data.
content: Because the POS is designed to work without internet, daily transaction data is first stored on your device. When your device connects to the internet, this data is synced to Fibidy's servers so you can access it from anywhere and it won't be lost if your device is damaged or lost.

sections.title: Why we collect this data.
content: The data we collect is used to run the online store and POS features as you use them, sync POS transaction data across devices and sessions, contact you about your account, plan, or service updates, and provide support when you reach out to our team.
We do not sell or rent your account data to third parties for advertising purposes.

sections.title: Who can see your online store data.
content: Information you display on your online store page (products, photos, descriptions, contact details) is public anyone who accesses the link can see it, because that is its purpose (so potential customers can view and contact you).
Your POS transaction data and account data are private only accessible by you through your account.

sections.title: Storage and security.
content: Data is stored on servers we maintain with standard security practices. That said, no system is 100% risk-free we do our best to keep your data as secure as possible, and we recommend you also keep your account credentials confidential (password, device access).

sections.title: Your rights over your data.
content: You can download a backup of your store data anytime through the feature available in your account, request us to delete your account data by contacting admin@fibidy.com, and update your account or store data anytime through the dashboard.

sections.title: Policy changes.
content: If there are changes to this policy, we will notify you via email or a notification in your account.

sections.title: Contact us.
content: Questions about your data privacy? Contact us at admin@fibidy.com.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
summary: Fibidy only uses functional cookies (for login and session management).
We do not use advertising cookies or third-party trackers.
These cookies must be enabled for you to stay logged in and use the dashboard.

sections.title: What cookies are.
content: Cookies are small files stored by your browser or app so that a website or app can "remember" you for example, keeping you logged in as you navigate between pages.

sections.title: Cookies we use.
content: Fibidy only uses functional cookies: login session cookies (to keep you signed in to your account as you navigate the dashboard) and lightweight preference cookies (for example, saving your chosen language or display settings).
Fibidy does not use advertising cookies, third-party tracking cookies (such as Google Analytics), or cookies that follow your activity across other websites.

sections.title: Why these cookies are necessary.
content: Login session cookies are essential for Fibidy's basic functionality without them, you would have to log in again every time you navigate to a new page. Because of this, these cookies cannot be disabled while you are using Fibidy.

sections.title: Managing cookies.
content: You can still manage or delete cookies through your browser or device settings. Please note that deleting login session cookies will sign you out of your account and require you to log in again.

sections.title: Policy changes.
content: If Fibidy adds new types of cookies in the future (for example, for analytics), we will update this page and notify you.

sections.title: Contact us.
content: Questions about cookies? Contact us at admin@fibidy.com.

items.question: Is the POS really free?
items.answer: The offline POS is active on the Starter plan (Rp 35,000/month) one payment and you're ready to go. The Free plan still includes an online store, but in a limited version and without the POS.

items.question: Why POS + online store together, not just one?
items.answer: Because they serve different needs that often go hand in hand. The offline POS records all your daily transactions sales, stock, revenue reports, history accessible anytime, even without a signal. The online store makes your business discoverable and reachable by potential customers from outside. One for internal operations, one for external reach Fibidy brings both together in one platform.

items.question: What types of businesses is it suitable for?
items.answer: Fibidy has dedicated versions for more than 20 business types, each with features built for that sector. A few examples: Pharmacy (FEFO system, batch & expiry tracking, prescription forms), Bakery (daily freshness tracking, pre-orders with deposit), Barbershop (queue management, booking, stylist commissions), Gym (memberships, renewals, member freezing), Boarding house (room management, check-in/out, automated rent billing), Laundry (real-time order status), Auto repair (service kanban, vehicle and mechanic records), Farm supply store (credit/installment system), and Minimarket (Purchase Orders and supplier management). Whatever your business, Fibidy most likely already has a version that fits.

items.question: How do customers pay at my online store?
items.answer: Customers browse products on your store page, then contact you directly via WhatsApp, phone, or the contact details you provide. Payment is handled via QRIS. Fibidy is not involved in the transaction at all.

items.question: Does Fibidy hold my sales money?
items.answer: No. Fibidy is not a marketplace and never receives, holds, or forwards money from your transactions. All price agreements and payments happen directly between you and your customers.

items.question: Can I take my data if I leave?
items.answer: Yes. Your business data remains yours there's a backup button to save it anytime. Need help with the migration process? Our team is ready to assist reach out and we'll handle it.

items.question: Can I migrate from another platform to Fibidy?
items.answer: Yes. Bring your product photos, descriptions, and prices everything can be moved to Fibidy. Our team is ready to assist with the migration directly just send a message and we'll take care of the heavy lifting.

items.question: If I stop paying for Starter, will my store data be deleted?
items.answer: No. Your account downgrades to the Free plan limits, but your data (products, photos, POS transaction history) stays intact. You can resubscribe to Starter anytime to reactivate the restricted features.
